entities.name: Jolly Balloon Man
entities.description: A Razorkin human clown of Duskmourn who skins victims' heads to make balloon mementos.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The plane where the Jolly Balloon Man lives.

events.summary: The Jolly Balloon Man exterminated an entire survivor group one at a time, placing each victim's balloon head where the survivors would find it.
events.quote: he exterminated an entire survivor group, one at a time
